quests.name: Speak with Our Discord
quests.description: Follow the floating marker to the Discord NPC at spawn and interact with it.

startActions.content: Follow the floating <h>objective marker</h> and speak with <h>Our Discord</h> at spawn. The distance appears while you are more than 10 blocks away.

completeActions.speaker: Our Discord
completeActions.content: Welcome to Skyblock! Link your account so your Discord roles, rewards, and Minecraft account stay connected.

quests.name: Link Your Discord
quests.description: Use /discord link and finish the linking flow.

startActions.content: Use <h>/discord link</h> and finish the link in Discord. This objective completes only after your account is actually linked.

quests.name: Vote Twice
quests.description: Use /vote and complete two votes toward your free rank.

startActions.content: Open <h>/vote</h> and complete two votes. Your real lifetime vote count is checked automatically.

quests.name: Create Your Island
quests.description: Use /is create, choose an island, and travel there with /is home.

startActions.content: Use <h>/is create</h>, choose your island, then use <h>/is home</h>. Your island is detected automatically.

quests.name: Mine 16 Generator Blocks
quests.description: Mine 16 blocks from the cobblestone generator on your island.

startActions.content: Mine <h>16 generator blocks</h> on your island. The generator can produce ores as you progress.

quests.name: Expand Your Island
quests.description: Place 16 blocks on your island to make more room.

startActions.content: Use the blocks you mined to place <h>16 blocks</h> anywhere on your island.

quests.name: Browse the Shop
quests.description: Open /shop and look through the server economy.

startActions.content: Open <h>/shop</h> to see what your island can buy and sell.

quests.name: Make Your First Sale
quests.description: Successfully sell an eligible item through the shop or /sell hand.

startActions.content: Sell an eligible item through the shop or with <h>/sell hand</h>. Only a successful sale counts.

quests.name: Review Island Settings
quests.description: Use /is settings and learn where island permissions are controlled.

startActions.content: Use <h>/is settings</h>. You can manage teammates with <h>/is members</h> and their access with <h>/is perms</h>.

quests.name: Claim Your Free Rank
quests.description: Open /freerank, meet the requirements, and claim the permanent rank.

startActions.content: Open <h>/freerank</h> and claim it after meeting the listed requirements. If you already own it, this objective completes automatically.

completeActions.content: Free rank claimed! Your guide will now introduce the systems that help you progress further.

quests.name: Speak with the Enchanter
quests.description: Follow the marker to the Enchanter and learn about enchant orbs.

completeActions.speaker: Enchanter
completeActions.content: Enchant orbs offer special boosts for your gear. Each orb has its own chance, success rate, and destroy rate.

quests.name: Speak with the Tinkerer
quests.description: Visit the Tinkerer and learn how enchant dust improves your orbs.

completeActions.speaker: Tinkerer
completeActions.content: Tinker dust upgrades enchant orbs and improves their effectiveness. Each dust piece has its own chance to succeed or fail.

quests.name: Visit the Coin Shop
quests.description: Speak with the Coin Shop NPC and see where activity coins are spent.

completeActions.speaker: Coin Shop
completeActions.content: Earn coins from mining, farming, and mob grinding, then trade them here for helpful boosts and limited rewards.

quests.name: Learn About Outposts
quests.description: Speak with the Outpost NPC to learn about server-wide boosts.

completeActions.speaker: Outposts
completeActions.content: Capture and control outposts to unlock exclusive multipliers, discounts, and powerful boosts.

quests.name: View the Top Islands
quests.description: Visit the Island Top NPC and see the islands you are competing against.

completeActions.content: You now know the core Skyblock systems. New guided objectives can continue to be added here as more server features open.

completeActions.speaker: Island Top
completeActions.content: These are the islands leading the current map. Grow your island value to climb the rankings.
